All original World/events/state/night.damage/night.deathLives property reads preserve complete lexical order and count; metadata does not add World, clock or target eligibility reads.

Facts, required records, gun accumulation and lucky expiry precede ledger. Receipt is returned only after original inheritance succeeds. Throw keeps actual earlier lives/ledger/facts, without reporting whole-command success. Per-target additional receipts cannot roll back later publication/cancel/target failure.

Entry uses still-Poison own data and original origin target/source body+version matching committed ledger; changed replaceable route.target scope is not authority. Missing, replaced, unversioned, stale or opaque metadata is unknown, not permission or a new reason.

Publication links are internal associations, not a new event-audience authorization, and actual receipts do not grant death-gun targets.
